dashboard.title: Accounting
dashboard.description: Drafts to review, invoices waiting for payment and what came in this month.

queues.overdueHint: Past the due date, oldest first

list.title: Invoices
list.description: Every monthly and one-time invoice. Filters are kept in the address, so a view can be shared.
list.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters. Clear them to see every invoice.

generate.title: Generate invoices
generate.description: Draft the monthly invoice for one partner, or for every active partner at once.
generate.onePartnerHint: One draft will be created and opened.
generate.allPartnersHint: Every active partner gets a draft. Partners already invoiced for the period are skipped.
generate.partnerHint: Leave on the first option to bill everyone.
generate.templateDisabledHint: Choose a partner to pick a specific template.
generate.skipped_one: {{count}} partner skipped: already invoiced for the period.
generate.skipped_other: {{count}} partners skipped: already invoiced for the period.

duplicate.title: Already invoiced for this period
duplicate.description: This partner already has an invoice for {{period}}. Open it, or create another draft anyway.

adhoc.title: New one-time invoice
adhoc.description: Bill something outside the monthly cycle: a setup fee, a training day, hardware.
adhoc.subject: Subject
adhoc.linesHint: Amounts in {{currency}}. Quantity can be a decimal.
adhoc.linesNoPartner: Choose a partner to see the currency.

void.title: Void {{number}}?
void.description: A void invoice cannot be issued or paid again. Billed work becomes available for the next invoice.
void.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this invoice being voided?

lines.title: Line items
lines.blankHint: Rows without a description are dropped when you save.

tasks.title: Tasks billed
tasks.description: Support work verified in the period, priced in points.
tasks.empty: No support tasks were billed on this invoice

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.switchHint: Off: VAT is added on top of the lines.

issue.title: Issue invoice
issue.description: Issuing locks the lines. Leave a date as it is to use the default.
issue.issuedHint_monthly: Default: last day of the period
issue.dueBeforeIssued: The due date cannot be before the issue date.

paid.title: Mark as paid
paid.beforeIssued: The payment date cannot be before the issue date.

editLines.title: Edit lines
editLines.description: Replace the lines of {{number}}. Totals update when you save.

email.title: Send by email
email.description: Send {{number}} to the partner's billing contacts.
email.toHint: Prefilled from the partner's billing e-mails. Press Enter after each address.
email.attachmentNote: The invoice PDF is attached automatically.

validation.price: Enter a price of 0 or more.
validation.noLines: Add at least one line with a description.

errors.invoice_invalid_transition: This invoice is not in a state that allows that action.
errors.invoice_has_no_lines: An invoice without lines cannot be issued.
errors.invoice_duplicate_period: This partner already has an invoice for the period.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
